Hidden_Challenges.name: Beatwidow
Hidden_Challenges.description: A dancing spider? This Invizimal world is full of surprises! I present Beatwidow, the queen of the disco, who can break dance or as a robot... Whatever you want!! This creature is such a good dancer that she has a disco ball in her stomach. By the way, watch that ball... maybe you can use it in more... dangerous ways!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Firecracker
Hidden_Challenges.description: Firecrackers were mentioned in ancient papyrus seven hundred years ago. These mighty creatures of fire and ash dwell in the depths of volcanoes like Mount Vesuvius. Dawson and Kenichi discovered them in their first adventure, and since then Dawson always carries one of these around, as his personal pet.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Flameclaw
Hidden_Challenges.description: Deep in the Egyptian desert, in a climate so hot it set his body on fire, lives the Flameclaw. A strange scorpion-like creature, Flameclaw combines poison with fire in a fatal cocktail, spiced with an arrogant personality. This creature is really king of the desert, and is notorious for behaving as such.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Fossilizaur
Hidden_Challenges.description: Some creatures can change the colour of their skin at will: Chameleons, some lizards and the Fossilzaur, the Invizimal that lives in caves. Changing your colour has become a survival strategy: you can disguise yourself, wait patiently and catch your prey by surprise. But in the dark caves do not happen many things, so sometimes the Fossilzaur has to wait. And wait.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Griffonator
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Griffonators are stalkers reptiles roaming the banks of rivers in India. Fast and loud, they have the ability to fly short distances using their little wings so they can fly on their prey, and silently attack from above with a lethal blow.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Minotaur
Hidden_Challenges.description: Minotaur used to be free to roam the earth... But they are so dangerous; a king in ancient Greece had to build a labyrinth to hold them! Now you helped one of them escape, this angry, fierce Invizimal owes you a debt of gratitude...

Hidden_Challenges.name: Porcupain
Hidden_Challenges.description: Deep in Hawaii Volcanoes live Porcupain, a race of strong warriors who just want to eat, sleep and fight. The Porcupains have the ability to stretch his body, which used to surprise their enemies. But every warrior has a weakness and Porcupains often have nightmares. Make sure that your Porcupain sleep well and will be a loyal companion!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Shizoku
Hidden_Challenges.description: In feudal Japan, everyone could become a hero. Take Shizoku, for example. Once a happy pig grazing the farm lands, he's now become a full-blown warrior in armor. Imagine the face of the farmers when they saw him coming out of the stables, dressed ears to hoof in full samurai regalia!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Stingwing
Hidden_Challenges.description: Stingwing was the first Invizimal Kenichi ever captured. A playful insect, don't let her looks deceive you: Stingwing can generate powerful electrical shocks that make her as attractive... as she is dangerous. Experienced players never underestimate them in combat.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Toxitoad
Hidden_Challenges.description: Some Invizimals are pretty... And some are like Toxitoad! Nobody knows exactly how this toad ended up in a toxic dump, but everyone can see the effects on him: Acid attacks, toxic fumes and a personality to match is all you can expect from this true madman. Oh, and he loves Heavy Metal music. Can it get any worse?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Usako
Hidden_Challenges.description: Years ago there was a geisha named Usako, who played a decisive role in ancient Japan. This mysterious dancer was not an appreciated entertainment for the rich and noble: she was also one of the best spies and her beauty was comparable to her ability to infiltrate.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Xue Hu
Hidden_Challenges.description: Contemplate Xue Hu, the powerful white tiger of the sky, fourth and most powerful protector of the tomb of the dragon emperor. Unknown by the majority, feared by all, only the warriors who defeat the first three guardians will face him in battle and will see him spread his wings in flames.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Flamigerodon
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Flamigerodon is a very intelligent Invizimal. It can create flames with its bare hands! It is so proud not to use it as a weapon. Unfortunately it can not control its power very well. You know what they say: If you play with fire, you could burn yourself!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Pahoehoe
Hidden_Challenges.description: Pahoehoe is a beast that lives in volcanoes all over the world. Whenever she is furious, she becomes a lava that floods everything the surrounding area, burning it to the ground. Only those who enter her palace of fire shall see her face.

Hidden_Challenges.name: T-Rex
Hidden_Challenges.description: So the Invizimals and the dinosaurs are connected in some way? Well, look at this powerful T-Rex if you need proof. The T-Rex were extinguished eons ago, but somehow they are alive and kicking... in the wave, in the Invizimal world.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Flameclaw
Hidden_Challenges.description: This is a strange creature... Looks like a Flameclaw, but it's... Evil. Aggressive. Dark. The Dark Flameclaw we shall call him. What a really mean guy. Loves to show-off, like all Flameclaws do, but his attacks have been boosted and he seems to be angrier. Use him with care. We need to learn more about these new kind of Invizimals.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Sandflame
Hidden_Challenges.description: What do you get if you apply the ritual of transformation to a cute little Sandflame? Well, you get a cute little Dark Sandflame! Unsurprised? What if we told you Dark Sandflames have massive stamina, and not only that, but massive stamina recovery? Yes, you got it: Dark Sandflames keep fighting. And fighting. And fighting.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Xue Hu
Hidden_Challenges.description: In the Chinese province of Fujian have been aware of the existence of blue tigers for centuries. From there comes the Dark Xue Hu: A Xue Hu was lying next to a lake on a full moon night, and by some kind of spell, his skin turned pale blue. It is an exceptional creature, which can only be obtained in the transformation ritual, so when you meet one, treat it well!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Fire Dragon
Hidden_Challenges.description: FIRE breathing dragons have been feared in Europe since medieval ages. The most common type of dragon, the Invizimal Fire Dragon obviously does breathe fire, so don't stand in his way!!! But he also has some hidden tricks, such as the ability to summon hell, generating an electrical charge that sets everything around him in flames.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Gold Dragon
Hidden_Challenges.description: A four-winged dragon? And made of gold? Invizimals have some strange ways of doing things, and the Gold Dragon is no different. It is said that it was born from the jewel of the crown of an ancient pharaoh, shining more than the sun with its wings. But whatever your story, you're really going to shine in any competition when you have this creature!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Erebus
Hidden_Challenges.description: Look! Is that a mountain of ice? Oh, it can not be, it's moving! Wait, it's Erebus, a mythical creature from the Antarctic! Great as a mountain, cold as ice, Erebus does not want problems with the outside world. But if you are looking for problems, you will find them! This creature has lived in solitude for millennia and knows how to defend itself!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Freezefur
Hidden_Challenges.description: Freezefur is a big angry beast! These Invizimals are fierce, violent and impatient... be careful when you approach one of them, they are very territorial creatures... Only the best Invizimals hunters should dare to do it, the rest could get into serious problems!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Headhorn
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Native Americans feared the Headhorn, the bison, but they also needed this creature. By their wool flesh or milk the bison were key to many Indian nations. In the Invizimal world, the Headhorns have developed new defences. Have you ever seen a bison use its horns like a boomerang? Well, then you're going to be surprised!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Hilltopper
Hidden_Challenges.description: Here is the noble Hilltopper. Arising from the forests of central Europe, Hilltoppers love to climb high mountains and jump from peak to peak. But don't get it wrong, this is not just a happy jumping Invizimal. Mess with a Hilltopper, and you'll have to face his sharp horns and strong hooves.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Icelion
Hidden_Challenges.description: Icelions live in the Polar Regions ,very rarely making contact with humans. A lonely but brutal hunter, no creature is a match for his strength. Still, this icy giant only has one known weak spot: his body is made completely of ice and so direct sunlight and heat can make him melt.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Ironbug
Hidden_Challenges.description: Ironbugs are the spirits of Japanese warriors from centuries ago. Legend says that their souls live in the snowy mountains in the north of Hokkaido, building swords and shields from ice preparing for battle. Ironbugs are thus noble and strong, loyal Invizimals you should keep and grow. Don't let the looks of an Ironbug pup deceive you: in this small creature lies the spirit of a warrior.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Neko-Suke
Hidden_Challenges.description: Neko-Suke was the name of one of Japan's most famous ninja... he was so stealthy, his enemies believed he could turn into a cat! Guess what? He actually could! Neko-Suke is a master of deception, stealth and mystery! You will only see one if he wants you to see it.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Sabretooth
Hidden_Challenges.description: Poor Sabretooth is the guardian of the park, which protects him in the long winter nights. Very strong, but silly, he does his job very well and dreams of becoming a superhero, but in reality he is an insecure Invizimal who only wants company and friends.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Skysaur
Hidden_Challenges.description: Did you know that dinosaurs laid eggs, right? Well, Skysaurs do too. But one in his life. So it is not surprising that these flying dinosaurs spend almost all day watching their single egg. Protecting it from harm. But beware, your egg is also your best weapon. So get ready to dodge a deadly release of an egg.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Skytalon
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Skytalons are huge eagles worshiped by the Native Americans who lived in the prairies of what are now the United States. Noble, loyal and brave, a Skytalon never gets into trouble and, if he does, he will never ask for help or compassion: These creatures can take good care of themselves or of you!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Steeltail
Hidden_Challenges.description: Don't be fooled by the innocent, sweet looks of the Steeltail. This bird may look friendly, but her tail is a powerful weapon. So whenever you come across a Steeltail, and see her smile at you candidly... enjoy the moment! A second later, she will turn around and strike.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Tunderwulfe
Hidden_Challenges.description: In the arctic plains swept by the wind, where nothing else can live, the Tunderwulfes roam happy. Fast and relentless hunters, the Tunderwulfes have sharp claws that they use to cling to the ground during the strongest blizzards. Obviously these claws are also perfect for fighting against other Invizimals!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Zaglossus
Hidden_Challenges.description: Zaglossus is a curious, inquisitive Invizimal. While he is young, he usually get into trouble because of that curiosity although they don’t really mean any harm! Their usual reactions to those situations is to become a ball, pointing the needles on their back towards any possible enemies.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Sanctacaris
Hidden_Challenges.description: Paleontologists believe the creatures of legend didn't exist, but there are many unearthed jewels still to be dug out. Take Sanctacaris, for example, he is skilled in hand-to-hand combat. Who knows, maybe modern boxers and karate fighters could learn a thing or two from him?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Scissorbeak
Hidden_Challenges.description: Scissorbeaks are reptiles that dig tunnels and can use their entire body as a drill. This they use to catch their enemies by surprise: appearing before them from a huge hole in the ground, or charging against a helpless enemy. But that's not all the Scissorbeak has. Have you heard of... vomiting acid?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Snowcaster
Hidden_Challenges.description: Snowcaster is a mystical sage, a shaman, the supreme lord of the ice! He lives in the deepest glaciers and spend most of the day meditating or training. His actions are calm, measured, in control... He isn't arrogant, but he knows he is much more powerful than most of his opponents!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Unicorn
Hidden_Challenges.description: The unicorn is not a mythological creature, but one in which people have believed for centuries! We know these creatures were Invizimals so you can add unicorns to your collection. But like the mythological ones, they are timid and hard to find. If you have one treat it well or it will flee.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Yeti
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Yeti lives on the highest peaks of the Himalayas. Half human, half monster, but all energy and strength. The Yetis are timid and have remained hidden for millennia. So do not provoke a Yeti unless you want trouble. And when you catch one take good care of it. It is a rare discovery that you should appreciate.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Icelion
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Dark Icelion, the grand master of all dark ones. This is the only creature who could confront Campbell and, using his massive claws, bring him to the shadow zone to meet his destiny. Why would a dark one turn against his master? After all, the Dark Icelion is utterly corrupted by Campbell's evil influence... Or maybe he is not?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Ice Dragon
Hidden_Challenges.description: Dragons have adapted to live in the icy Antarctic plains. The Ice Dragon lives in glaciers, and has developed an icicle skin that protects him. Not that there are many predators around, but in case someone dared confront him, Ice Dragon can freeze enemies with his icy breath or, if need be, summon a jungle of ICE spikes around him as protection.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Spectral Dragon
Hidden_Challenges.description: Have you ever heard the laughter of a Spectral Dragon in a dark night?... Maybe at some point this Invizimal died, but he refused to stay that way! This evil Invizimal was created in the most frightening nightmares. With him by your side the battle will be a lot easier... That is, if your brave enough!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Bandolero
Hidden_Challenges.description: In Mexico and Honduras, they call these crow-like Invizimals Bandoleros for their ability to steal stuff from us. Bandoleros are not very strong, but they are indeed brave, showing off and acting proud even in front of much larger creatures. Put a Bandolero in front of a dragon and you will see what we mean. This creature never runs away, even when he should.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Bratbat
Hidden_Challenges.description: Imagine a large castle, now, imagine a spoilt vampire kid living in it. Yes, that's Bratbat, the most mischievous of all Invizimals. Bratbats only like to perform pranks and scare humans. But never forget this is indeed a vampire, and not a toy. Campbell used an especially trained Bratbat in his final battles. Are you sure you want to play with him?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Chupacabra
Hidden_Challenges.description: Chupacabra is a legendary animal, only rumoured to exist, but never seen, until now!! The vampire that haunts the night. Half-bat, half-dragon, this flying beast can hover over its prey and, before they know it, it's all over and the Chupacabra has disappeared into the night. So you're very lucky you caught one: not many people have seen one of these, and can live to tell the tale.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Furmin
Hidden_Challenges.description: Some Invizimals have come closer to humans than others. For example let's take the Furmin. We could not imagine that the Invizimals lived right below us, in our sewers. The Furmins are little hooligans, who enjoy laughing at us, misbehaving and stealing food. Adorable? I do not think so! But such an annoying creature in the middle of a bout is a sight!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Goldbug
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Egyptian pharaohs were buried carrying a Goldbug, a beetle-shaped earring. The Goldbugs symbolized the passage to eternity. Thousands of years later, this Goldbug has come back to life under the influence of the Dark Invizimals. Fast and hard, Goldbug may not be worth much as an attacker, but it sure is difficult to defeat.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Gotica
Hidden_Challenges.description: Dark and dangerous, Gotica is one of the most dangerous creatures in the Mexican jungle. Feared by the Mayan, feared by the Spanish conquerors... well, you can imagine: its small size hides its immense power. Of course he will not be a creature to rely on easily.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Ha Ha Yena
Hidden_Challenges.description: Ha Ha Yena is the joker of the savannah. She is always looking for someone to make fun of, whether it's a lost adventurer, the Maasa, or other animals in danger-She'll even laugh at stones! But she better watch out: sometimes the one who laughs last, laughs strongest.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Hipporockamus
Hidden_Challenges.description: Here it is, the spoiled child of the savannah. Hipporockamus is always complaining and crying... crying so much that he can become dehydrated. And you know that hippos have to be always wet. This is a tough creature to keep! But beware: his enormous size and strong legs make him a formidable warrior.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Meep Meep
Hidden_Challenges.description: Meep Meep is the fastest creature in Africa. So fast that he almost never has to fight: he just runs away. What's so funny about having an Invizimal that does not want to fight? Well, take a Meep Meep to a combat arena and you'll be amazed. When they can not flee, they are actually good fighters.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Pesci
Hidden_Challenges.description: Pesci is the name of an Egyptian musical instrument made of clay, with which the Pharaohs used to play melodies. This camel Invizimal was named after the Pesci for its uncanny ability to make beautiful music. So now we have a musical camel loose in the Egyptian desert. Is not it funny? No, it's not, so you'd better catch him before someone notices!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Raptor
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Raptors are dangerous hunters! They are fast, intelligent and aggressive, always alert and ready to attack, always looking for new prey. They can be cunning, stealthy and roguish brawlers, often looking for a fight!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Roarhide
Hidden_Challenges.description: The African savannah can be a dangerous place, but unless so if you are Roarhide, the boxing champion of the Invizimal World. Roarhides combine powerful punches and blows with a fully armoured body. This makes them a fearsome enemy, but a champ is not only a body: Roarhides are arrogant and brave, with a mind designed to win every combat.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Salma
Hidden_Challenges.description: Some Invizimals thrive because they are strong. Others have to be smart, like Salma. What would you do if you had a frail body and your only protection was your poison? Salma know the answer very well. He slowly dance for his enemy, moving slowly closer. And then with a sudden movement spit their venom in the face of his enemy.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Sandflame
Hidden_Challenges.description: Sandflame was the pet of the pharaoh, who loved to play with this hyperactive creature. Pharaoh was so close to Sandflame, this creature was buried with pharaoh. Thus, Sandflame became a spirit, and the spirit became an Invizimal, guarding the tomb of the pharaoh for thousands of years from intruders... until you found them.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Shellshocked
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Shellshocked is a creature of magic! Living on his own inside caves has made him eccentric and maybe a little crazy... He is always moving and performing ritual dances that only make him more powerful... Watch out of his ink - it is very flammable!

Hidden_Challenges.name: Vipera
Hidden_Challenges.description: Very few Invizimals live in caves. They prefer open spaces. But only one Invizimal, we know, actually lives in a hole! Yes, it Vipera, a horrible creature that digs his hole at birth and hidden there throughout their life. Lazy and rude, Vipera never strays too far from his lair, where he becomes perceived as problems.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dimetrodon
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Dimetrodon was an impressive hunter reptile that lived almost 300 million years ago. He used his huge fin to cool off in summer and to scare other creatures with their impressive size. Invizimal has somehow arrived in the world. Invizimals and dinosaurs were connected in some way. Is not it strange... and surprising?

Hidden_Challenges.name: Uberjackal
Hidden_Challenges.description: Ancient Egyptians had lots of idols they worship, like the massive Überjackal, one of the rare Invizimals. This powerful creature is only seen by man in his Max stage, and has somehow unleashed the power of magic. Thus, he doesn't need to use his physical strength, but his powerful spells to win a battle.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Bratbat
Hidden_Challenges.description: Campbell used a Bratbat in his last fight in the Snake Pit, so it is logical that mutate an Invizimal, so powerful for your little pet project, the Dark Bratbat. This creature is where Campbell poured all his evil influence to create a horrible flying monster, feared by the rest of the creatures of the wave.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Dark Uberjackal
Hidden_Challenges.description: The Dark Überjackal is the Egyptian lord of fire and destruction. Legend has it that this creature can only be raised during solar eclipses, as it absorbs the energy of the Dying Sun with its flaming wings. A true champion in combat, if you fight against him your only option will be to exhaust his resistance, since these creatures tend to tire quickly.

Hidden_Challenges.name: Desert Dragon
Hidden_Challenges.description: This legendary Invizimal lives in caves in the Gobi Desert in Mongolia, one of the hottest places in the world. Mainly nocturnal hunter, this dragon has the special ability to turn night into day, invoking at will a flaming sun. Use this surprising attack to paralyze your enemy with fear… or maybe to roast?
